description: Pixelate (mosaic blocks) or blur an entire image or a specified percentage bounding box (x, y, width, height) to anonymize faces, license plates or private text before publishing. Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.002/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/pixelate-image.
